learning_outcomes.text: Can select the correct machining process for the given type of element being manufactured
Can select correct cutting process parameters using catalogues of cutting tools for a given set of workpiece material and cutting edge material.
Knows the basic types of tool materials and their application in machining processes

syllabus_topics: Geometric and kinematic parameters of cutting
Movements of tools and workpieces during machining
Geometry of a cutting tool analysed in tool-in-hand system and in tool-in-use system
A phenomenon of chip formation and kinds of chips
Heat and temperature in cutting area
Tool materials and rules of their selection
Basic ways of cutting: turning, milling, drilling, deepening, boring
Parting-off materials and machine-tools for cutting-off
Cutting on planning machines and vertical shapers
assessment_rules: To pass the laboratory, a score of 100% is required. To pass the written exam, a score of 56% is required.

degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
